root_causes_fixed.fix: Separated explicit_entities (current query) from context_entities (prior turns). Step 8 (ORDER) now requires explicit order_id OR explicit order keywords, and does NOT fire when only a context-inherited order_id is present while the current query has explicit product entities.

Pre-turn slot snapshot taken before routing. ctx.update_slots_domain_aware() called only AFTER _check_ownership() succeeds. On security denial, ctx.revert_slots() restores pre-turn state so unauthorized IDs never persist.

New domain-aware slot update method. When a new explicit domain entity arrives (e.g. product_id), conflicting slots from unrelated domains (order_id, return_id, refund_id) are cleared. Same-domain follow-ups with no explicit entities leave context unchanged.
